title: AgentEvent
description: Agent lifecycle and processing-result event published to the agent-events topic. Record key = correlationId when present, else the agent name. The UI listener (SSE GET /api/events/stream?processingId=...) completes when an event of type REQUEST_COMPLETED, REQUEST_FAILED or REQUEST_BLOCKED carries the watched processingId as correlationId; the UI then refreshes the conversation from chat history.

type.description: REQUEST_COMPLETED/REQUEST_FAILED/REQUEST_BLOCKED are terminal for a processing request; AGENT_STARTED/AGENT_STOPPED are lifecycle events.

agentName.description: Name of the agent the event is about (master for chat processing).

detail.description: Human-readable detail (e.g. the refusal reason for REQUEST_BLOCKED, the error for REQUEST_FAILED).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant the event was raised.

correlationId.description: Processing UUID of the originating processing request; null for lifecycle events.
